title: 명예교수규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text: Article 3 (Qualifications) A person eligible for conferment of the title of emeritus professor shall be a person who served as a faculty member at the rank of assistant professor or higher at the relevant university for at least the period prescribed by its school regulations, and who, at retirement, was the president, dean, or professor (including a public official dispatched to Seoul National University Corporation pursuant to Article 3 (2) of the Addenda to the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Establishment and Operation of Seoul National University Corporation who was the president, dean, or professor at retirement), and whose educational and academic achievements during service were so outstanding as to serve as an example to other faculty members.
